The '''Nuiri sector''' was a [[sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Head to Head" /> that was home to the [[Stygeon system]], a [[star system]] that held the [[planet]] [[Stygeon Prime]].<ref name="Epic Battles" />
